message: ゾンビで会長

name: Lolotte
message: 「You're quite the glutton, aren't you, Treasurer?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Picking a fight right in the middle of work? Well, as a true child of Edo, I've gotta take you up on it!」

name: Synn
message: 「You're a child of Ryusei, though」

name: Lolotte
message: 「My guidebook said that someone who constantly repeats the names of food is a glutton」

name: Misa
message: 「Ah, 'sweets,' right?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Shweets!」

name: Ria
message: 「Now, now. Nanaka-chan's pronunciation is just extraordinarily good, so it can't be helped」

name: Nanaka
message: 「No, this isn't an issue of pronunciation or anything like that」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Were you always such a big glutton even back in the old days?」

name: Sally
message: 「Glutton, glutton, nyah-nyah!」

name: Synn
message: 「She didn't go around chanting 'sweets, sweets' all the time. Back then, anyway」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Is that so? That's surprising」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What's so surprising about it」

name: Synn
message: 「If anything, she was more like the neighborhood boss of the kids」

name: Misa
message: 「Tone-deaf and tyrannical, huh?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「That's pure prejudice! I've been a good kid since way back when. Right, Synn?」

name: Synn
message: 「I-I don't think you were tone-deaf, at least」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What was with that pause?!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「So you were tyrannical, then?」

name: Synn
message: 「Hrmmm」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I wasn't tyrannical! I had plenty of thoughtful, attentive sides to me, too!」

name: Synn
message: 「You were always running around, yeah」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Y-You were right there with me, weren't you!」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah. You were always dragging me around」

name: Misa
message: 「So Nanaka-san was the mastermind」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Don't make me sound like a criminal! Doesn't change the fact that we were in it together!」

name: Synn
message: 「It was a huge mess when we unhooked the leash on the Takamuras' bulldog... That thing was super vicious」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Don't tell me you were mauled to death!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Then he wouldn't be standing here」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hau! Could it be that President-san is a zombie!?」

name: Sally
message: 「Whoa, a zombie! You hardly ever see those even in the Demon World!」

name: Misa
message: 「So they do exist...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I'm the one who saved Synn from that dog! Ahem」

name: Ria
message: 「You were so brave」

name: Synn
message: 「You really came through for me back then. Though, you were the one who unhooked the leash in the first place, Nanaka」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Aaaah~~」

name: Misa
message: 「And there's the punchline」

name: Nanaka
message: 「N-No, that just happened to be the part that stuck in Synn's memory!」

name: Synn
message: 「We also played explorer a lot...」

name: Ria
message: 「You were quite the rascal, Synn-kun」

name: Synn
message: 「No. Nanaka came up with the plans, and Nanaka was the leader」

name: Nanaka
message: 「N-No, it couldn't have been like that every single time!」

name: Synn
message: 「Still, I wouldn't have done something as reckless as trying to circle all of Ryuusei Town by only walking on top of walls」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ahh, that was a blast, wasn't it...」

name: Synn
message: 「Sure was. Because we kept peeking into places, we got chased all over town--it was rough」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Treasurer-san is quite wild, isn't she」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I-I was just a kid being a kid!」

name: Misa
message: 「I certainly never did anything like that.」

name: Ria
message: 「Sorry. I didn't either.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Heav--ahem, ahem, in the country where I lived, there weren't even any fences or anything.」

name: Sally
message: 「Kids always mess up their magic and end up breathing fire. It's a miracle we survived.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Pretty sure that was just you.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Th-That's weird... This was supposed to be where the sepia-toned memories come out, creating a little world just for Synn and me...」

name: Synn
message: 「Brings back memories...」
They might just be silly little memories, but Nanaka and I have tons of things in common.
And that bond still continues today.
As my childhood friend... Nanaka was also the one who cheered me on the most when I said I wanted to have a sparkling school life, wasn't she?
Old memories are important too, of course, but the time we're weaving together right now is also super precious to me.
I wonder how Nanaka feels about it...?

name: Lolotte
message: 「So, do you not have any mulberry-purple memories?」

name: Ria
message: 「I think you mean sepia-toned?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hold on a second.」

name: Misa
message: 「Don't tell me you actually don't have any...?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「N-No, that's not it! My brain's just having an off day. Gotta tune it up.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Firecrackers... no, bad idea. Sword-fighting with daikon radishes... no, wrong, ding-dong ditch... wrong!」

name: Misa
message: 「You really don't have any.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Waaaait! Swapping eggplants for potatoes... no good either, the octopus incident! No, not that one... digging pitfalls all the time... wrooong!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「You really don't, do you.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「N-No, I'm telling you, that's not true\s01」

name: Synn
message: 「Hahaha, every single one of those brings back memories... Getting tied to a giant octopus as an experiment to see if I'd float in the air, huh...」

name: Misa
message: 「T-That's dangerous...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「C-Come on, we didn't go that far. All we did was tie a cat to it, right?」

name: Sally
message: 「What a dummy. You could've just flown normally」

name: Synn
message: 「No, that was me. I wrote 'Yuugiri-an Was Here' in huge letters on the kite」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ah... ugh. ...M-Maybe it was」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Did it fly? *Excited*」

name: Nanaka
message: 「It didn't fly. It was too heavy」

name: Lolotte
message: 「What a boring punchline」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Excuse me for that!」
I really miss the days when we thought something like that could fly...
